deadline.value: Apply by January 15 to be considered for funding.
deadline.quote: Applicants should apply by Jan 15 to be considered for funding.

gre_general.value: The department says there is no GRE score requirement, though scores may be submitted.
gre_general.quote: The is no GRE score requirement.

also.quote: However, if you have taken the GRE test(s), we encourage you to submit your official score(s).

gre_subject.value: No GRE is required, including the Mathematics subject test.
gre_subject.quote: Additional Requirements: No GRE required Coordinator: Dr. Puck Rombach

supervisor.value: Admission does not depend on a named faculty member; students choose a thesis advisor after joining.
supervisor.quote: Your statement about being interested to work with particular faculty member(s) will not constitute a commitment to do so; you will be free to explore the opportunities to work with any of our faculty as your thesis advisor if you join UVM.

funding.value: Fall applicants are automatically considered for a teaching assistantship; the page does not say most admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: Everyone applying for Fall admission will be automatically considered for financial support in the form of Graduate Teaching Assistantship.

entry_route.value: The admission requirement is a bachelor's degree in mathematics or a closely related field.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor's degree with a major in mathematics or a closely related discipline

notes: Department page also says fee waivers are not granted on financial need alone and are very limited (materials due December 20).
